deviation: The draft auto-renews for successive 12-month terms with only 30 days' non-renewal notice, against Arcadia's standard of no auto-renewal and a playbook minimum of 90 days. It also bars termination for convenience and has no cap on renewal price increases, so Arcadia could easily miss the short window and be locked into another year. Separately, the stated 24-month Initial Term does not match the November 22, 2028 end date, which should be checked against the Effective Date.
suggested_text: 2.1 This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and, unless terminated earlier in accordance with its terms, continues until [insert end date consistent with the 24-month term] (the "Initial Term"). 2.2 This Agreement does not renew automatically. Any extension of this Agreement requires a written agreement signed by both parties. 2.3 This Agreement may be terminated before the end of the Initial Term only in accordance with Section 13. [Fallback if auto-renewal is unavoidable: This Agreement renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives at least 90 days' written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term, and any increase in fees on renewal shall not exceed 5% of the fees in the preceding term.]
